## Summary
Brief description of changes.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New skill/command/template
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Validation/infrastructure improvement
- [ ] Upstream reference update
- [ ] Release-related change

## v1.0 Gates (release-related PRs)

- [ ] `npm run validate:all` passes
- [ ] `npm run validate:schemas` passes (if registry or schema files changed)
- [ ] `npm run validate:references` passes (if reference files changed)
- [ ] `npm run validate:traceability` passes (if commands, skills, templates, or doc links changed)
- [ ] `npm run smoke-test:cli` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes
- [ ] `npm run release:dry-run` succeeds (if release-related)
- [ ] `docs/DASHBOARD.md` regenerated and current (if dashboard data changed)
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP-STATUS.md` updated (if status changed)

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `npm run validate:references` passes (if references changed)
- [ ] Attribution updated in ATTRIBUTIONS.md (if adapting upstream)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md / docs/vi/)
- [ ] Registry updated (registry/skills.json or registry/prompts.json)
